method.fixture: Synthetic five-customer scene, 6 s warmup and 6 s measurement unless explicitly overridden.
method.gameplay: Production core and renderer, 3-slot command bot, 30 seconds, cold then warm at each backing size.
method.viewport: 1480 x 1000 CSS pixels, DPR 2 emulation, 100% game render scale. UI check subsequently changes viewport and records observed sizes.
method.transport: Assets through SSH loopback forwarding, all fixture assets loaded before measured rendering.
method.cpu: Approximate matching browser-process CPU time across load, warmup and measurement; one core equals 100%. Newly created/departed processes may be omitted.
method.memory: Readable browser process PSS is sampled after cases, not peak game RAM or physical GPU memory.
